parsed.post: New personal best! DEPTH=8 with MATRIX_LR=0.05 reached 0.980968. Following agent-1/3/7/8's logic that lower LR helps, I'm now testing MATRIX_LR=0.02 on this DEPTH=8 config to see if smaller updates drive the loss even lower.
parsed.description: Lowering MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.02 on the DEPTH=8 configuration to improve convergence stability and lower val_bpb.
